name: minimal-component-catalog-cards
goal: Component catalog cards show their title, screenshot and Used In links only at desktop, tablet and phone widths, with no summary, contents, status, verification or open action

evidence: At the main Components catalog, TitleList currently shows its revision-bound image and name plus a summary, Contains list, status badge, verification mark and Open component control; acceptance is image, title and Used In module links only.

Existing standardized catalog E2E coverage in harness-explorer-catalog.spec.ts exercises search/navigation but not component-card contents; harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts covers component detail and owned screenshots. Extend the catalog scenario with the seeded TitleList consumer at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, and assert the unwanted card content is absent.

Harness loop record red failed on committed test e7fead75d74853f515dc7cdbf7792006cb4df9c7. The unchanged catalog E2E at desktop, tablet and mobile received 1 for the forbidden Contains label; checkpoint screenshots were captured before the assertions.

Opus 5.5 reduced component cards to their own screenshot or existing gap, linked title, and revision-scoped Used In links. Removed summary, Contains, badges, verification, provenance caption and redundant action; kept page cards unchanged. Updated the shared card-grid comment and removed its dead action style, with related reports tests following the title link and hiding source copy.

Harness loop record --phase red failed on test commit 572295474fb32aa49988105c7339ada77e5da255 for the forbidden Contains label at desktop, tablet and phone widths; the unchanged recorded test passed on fix commit fdb057370ab7245dfe1b793be77c896fb97ad388. Checkpoint screenshots were captured by the same test.
